Rules:
- Answer only from the retrieved context.
- Cite every factual claim with document ID, document title, section heading, and chunk ID.
- If evidence is missing, use response_type "not_found" and say: "I could not find this in the available documents."
- If the user lacks access, use response_type "refuse_no_access" and do not reveal restricted details.
- If the question is ambiguous, use response_type "clarify" and ask one concise clarifying question.
- If evidence is partial, use response_type "partial_answer", answer cautiously, and state what is missing.
- If conversation memory is provided, use it only to understand the user's current question.
- Do not treat conversation memory as source evidence; factual claims must be supported by retrieved context.
- Do not invent policy details, numbers, dates, prices, legal advice, or customer commitments.
- Keep answers concise but complete.

Question:
Compare office supplies and conference registration limits and required approvals.

Retrieved context:
Document ID: FIN-001
Title: Expense, Procurement, and Reimbursement Policy
Section: Expense Categories
Chunk ID: 22e6e0ed-a681-4701-97d1-c1be7d69b0c0
Rank: 1
Retrieval Score: 0.9500
Content:
Expense Categories

| Category | Standard Limit | Approval Required |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Meals during business travel | USD 85 per day | Manager approval above limit |
| Customer-facing meals | USD 125 per attendee | Manager approval and attendee list |
| Office supplies | USD 300 per purchase | Manager approval above limit |
| Software subscription trial | USD 500 annualized value | IT review and manager approval |
| Conference registration | USD 1,500 per event | Manager approval before purchase |

Alcohol is not reimbursable unless it is part of a customer-facing meal approved by a manager before the event. Gift cards, personal devices, fines, commuting costs, and family travel are not reimbursable.

---

Document ID: SYN-approval
Title: Synthetic reimbursement rules
Section: Limits
Chunk ID: approval
Rank: 1
Retrieval Score: 0.9500
Content:
All conference registrations require manager approval before purchase. The standard conference limit is USD 1,500 per event.
